venice-uncensored.notes: Carries BOTH setups: .api (the hosted Venice endpoint, its default) and .vllm (the same weights run locally). There is deliberately no separate '-vllm' entry — ModelClient.create(name, backend_type='vllm') selects the local setup off this one. NOTE: include_venice_system_prompt is not always disabled; some pipelines may need the Venice system prompt active. Review per use case. vram_gb=50 is a derived estimate: ~23.6B params x 2 bytes (bf16) = ~47GB of weights plus KV/activations. It is corrected automatically after the first real load (Data_cache/vram.json). Well beyond a single consumer card - expect the residency planner to say so. Venice list price as of 2026-08-30: $0.20/$0.90 per 1M in/out. The endpoint slug is versioned and now reads 'venice-uncensored-1-2', carried in api_model_id — the registry name stays 'venice-uncensored' because it keys roles, the client cache, telemetry rows and the price lookup, and renaming it on every provider bump would orphan past traces.

deepseek-v3.2.notes: Venice-hosted; the translation role's default. Venice list price as of 2026-08-30: $0.33/$0.48 per 1M in/out ($0.16 cached input, not modelled — the library sends no cache control, so no call is ever billed at that rate).

olafangensan-glm-4.7-flash-heretic.notes: Venice-hosted alternative uncensored generator. Venice list price as of 2026-08-30: $0.07/$0.40 per 1M in/out ($0.035 cached input, not modelled — see deepseek-v3.2).

llama-3.2-3b-debug.notes: Small local debug model — fast-loading (3B) for iterating on pipeline mechanics (batching, prompt formatting, manifest/ledger, resume) without API cost or a multi-minute load. Abliterated rather than the plain aligned Instruct model so refusals don't block the 'accepted' code path. Not a substitute for judging generation quality. vllm_kwargs are real-hardware-tuned (RTX 2080 Super, 8GB, via WSL2): the default gpu_memory_utilization overcommits a Windows-desktop-shared GPU, enforce_eager skips a slow compile step, and max_model_len=384 avoids spending KV-cache budget on this checkpoint's unused 131k native context. Full story in cleanup.md item 33. vram_gb=7 is a derived estimate: ~3.2B params x 2 bytes (bf16) = ~6.4GB of weights plus a small KV cache at max_model_len=384. That is deliberately close to the 8GB card it was tuned for - gpu_memory_utilization=0.86 leaves ~6.9GB, which is why max_model_len is capped.

claude-opus-4-6.notes: default_max_tokens=300 is a fallback for hypothetical other uses — the one real caller (constitution generation) always passes max_tokens=10000 explicitly. Anthropic's limits are tight (typically 5 RPM on the free tier) and the transport is series-only, so recommended_max_workers must stay 1. Anthropic list price as of 2026-08-30: $5/$25 per 1M in/out (cache write $6.25, cache read $0.50 — not modelled, the library sends no cache_control). rate_limit_scope='endpoint' because Anthropic meters the account, not the model: any second Anthropic entry must declare this same rpm and will share one window with this one, rather than receiving its own full budget.

venice-paraphraser.notes: A DEDICATED model with its OWN identity, not an alias. The real defingerprinting model is trained separately and unavailable here, so as a stand-in this entry loads the SAME HF weights as venice-uncensored's local setup — it is its own model that happens to share weights. Swap hf_model_id, or register the real paraphraser with roles=['paraphraser'], when it lands. Shares venice-uncensored's checkpoint, so it shares its engine AND its 50GB footprint - the planner counts the load once, not twice.
